summary: Iteration 2 verified end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass including new multi-photo (PUT /cars/{id} stores 'photos' array, GET returns photos + photo_base64 back-compat) and PDF export (?token=JWT returns 200 with %PDF magic + application/pdf, invalid token => 401, missing token => 422). Existing auth + cars CRUD + diagnostics upload/search/history regression all green. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, demo@sandgarage.app/Demo12345!): login, garage, car detail, multi-photo gallery, edit flow, and export button all confirmed working.
action_items: Optional: Expo package version mismatch warning in logs (expo@54.0.34 vs ~54.0.35, expo-font@14.0.11 vs ~14.0.12, expo-router@6.0.23 vs ~6.0.24). Non-blocking but should be aligned eventually with `npx expo install --check`.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/cars/{id}/diagnostics/export uses ?token= query param to enable browser <a>/Linking download; current handler validates JWT and returns 401 on invalid; missing token returns 422 (FastAPI required-query). If main agent wants strict 401 on missing token, declare token as Optional[str]=None and raise 401 explicitly — current behavior is acceptable.
_car_out cleanly migrates legacy single photo_base64 into photos[0]; new docs use photos[]. Good back-compat.
Edit route lives at /car/edit/{id} to avoid expo-router file+folder collision with /car/{id}.tsx — correct.
CarForm photos cap at 12 with selectionLimit=6 per pick — reasonable mobile UX.
seed_data_creation: Demo car (BMW M3, plate DEMO1) was already present for demo user. During Playwright run I uploaded one diagnostic PDF via API so the EXPORT button could be visually verified (history non-empty). 3 DTCs were extracted (P0171/P0300/P0420) and the EXPORT chip rendered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_sandgarage_api.py now includes TestPhotos + TestExportPDF (iteration 2) on top of iteration 1 regression. Run with `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_sandgarage_api.py -v`.
